recommended_statement.parameters: Same positive alpha,beta,R,epsilon, supplied minimizer and C1 Hilbert/upper-radius solver contract as finite parent. Define q=alpha R²/epsilon>0, L=Real.log(q)/Real.log4, N=Nat.ceil L.
outputs: Actual same run/final point has objective gap<=epsilon, with finite natural cost<=N*phi(8kappa)+phi(kappa).
Casting the actual total cost to real gives <=(max(0,L)+1)*phi(8kappa)+phi(kappa), with explicit casts of natural phi values.
Optional implication phi(kappa)<=phi(8kappa) gives real total<=(max(0,L)+2)*phi(8kappa).
recommended_statement.no_global_phi_monotonicity: The main bound keeps both terms. The optional implication needs only the displayed two-point comparison; monotonic phi is a sufficient consumer condition, not required for main theorem.
recommended_statement.endpoint: For q<=1, L<=0 and N0. Still invoke actual final polishing call; this case does not collapse the cost or assert initial objective accuracy. R0 remains excluded by positive R, as in parent.

exact_apis.name: Nat.le_ceil
exact_apis.use: L<=(Nat.ceil L:real) for every real L, including negative L.

exact_apis.name: Nat.ceil_eq_zero
exact_apis.use: L<=0 implies N0; no max inside ceil needed.

exact_apis.name: Nat.ceil_lt_add_one
exact_apis.use: Requires 0<=L. Gives castN<L+1. For a global upper bound split L<=0 and L>0, then combine with max0L. Do not apply it unconditionally to negative L.

exact_apis.name: Real.log_pos; Real.log_pow; Real.log_le_log_iff
exact_apis.use: log4>0; log(4^N)=N*log4; positive q and4^N turn logq<=Nlog4 into q<=4^N.

exact_apis.name: div_pow; pow_mul; mul_pow; pow_pos; le_div_iff₀/div_le_iff₀
exact_apis.use: Rewrite alpha*(R/2^N)^2=alpha R²/4^N using (2^N)^2=(2²)^N=4^N, cancel only positive epsilon/powers.

exact_apis.name: Nat.cast_add; Nat.cast_mul; Nat.cast_nonneg; mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
exact_apis.use: Cast exact natural cost to real and multiply ceiling bound by nonnegative natural cost coefficients.

proof_route: Prove q>0, log4>0 and use Nat.le_ceil to derive logq<=Nlog4.
Use log_pow and log_le_log_iff to infer q<=4^N, then elementary positive algebra yields parent horizon alpha*(R/2^N)^2<=epsilon.
Apply the finite parent at exactly the defined Nat.ceil horizon and retain actual run/final definitions.
Derive castN<=max0L+1 by splitting nonpositive versus positive L with Nat.ceil_eq_zero and Nat.ceil_lt_add_one.
Cast the actual finite natural cost and multiply by nonnegative phi values to obtain the two-term real bound.
For the optional implication use only phi(kappa)<=phi(8kappa); combine addition to get max0L+2.
